Sectoare de activitate: Servicii financiare și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Ready to take your career global?
 Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Java Software Engineer to join our ever-evolving Global Gateway team and help shape the future of global commerce.
At Global Gateway, we are building a state-of-the-art payment gateway using current technologies and new ways of working. If you are curious, forward-thinking and love to collaborate to solve interesting challenges then we want to hear from you.
With us you will have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in payments industry. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate and above all fun.
 What You’ll Own
 You will collaborate with your cross-functional squad to design, develop, operate and improve the products our customers enjoy using. You will work with the wider engineering team to bring solutions to challenges that require cross squad collaboration. You will own the services and applications you develop, following a build-release-operate model. As a member of the squad you will also have good understanding of the product and industry you are building for.
 What You’ll Bring
Collaboratively develop the features and engineering capabilities for the products your squad own. We aim to employ automation for everything
Collaborate in all stages of development from requirement discussions with the Product Owner to the deployment of the feature in the cloud
Join the on-call rota to support the highly available products developed by the squad
Provide your squad with the tools to enable data driven decision making
Participate in driving decisions around technologies, patterns and approaches to adopt in collaboration with your fellow engineers from other squads
Experience in designing, implementing and operating large scale and highly available microservices deployed to the cloud
Experience building microservices with Docker, Spring Boot, Java and Reactive Programming
Experience with Test Driven Development
An engineering skillset that is focused on quality and a test first philosophy, regardless of the activity
An inquisitive personality that is always looking for constant improvement opportunity
 It’s a bonus if you have
Experience with Terraform, Kubernetes and AWS
Experience with Kafka or any other messaging-oriented middleware
Exposure to the Payments industry domain (especially Cards and other payment schemes)
Exposure to PCI-DSS
 About The Team
 Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.
 What makes a Globalpayer?
 Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.
Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.
